fullContent:
Pratap Lankeshwar Ras 
 Reference: Yoga Ratnakara Stri Roga Chikitsa. 
 Introduction 
 Pratap Lankeshwar Ras is an herbal formulation in the form of tablets or powder. It is used to treat chronic fever, diarrhea. This medicine should be taken under strict medical supervision as it contains heavy metal ingredients in a purified form. It balances Vata and Pitta doshas. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Purified mercury 
 Purified mica 
 Purified sulphur 
 Black pepper (Piper nigrum) 
 Iron bhasma 
 Conch shell bhasma 
 Cow dung cake bhasma 
 Aconitum ferox 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Clean and crush all the ingredients separately and mix them later and form tablets of 125 mg each. Store these tablets in an air tight jar. 
 Dosage 
 1 tablet twice a day after meals along with honey and ghee. 
 Indications 
 
 Teeth disorders 
 Diarrhea 
 Dysentery 
 Fever 
 Malabsorption syndrome 
 Puerperal disorders 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Over dosage might cause poisonous effects. 
 Self-medication is discouraged. 
 It should be avoided during pregnancy, lactation and in kids. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
